_about: The compat table: how to reach each provider and what is quirky about it. Hand-written; each quirk says where it comes from. Per-model facts (limits, vision, reasoning levels, prices, which field reasoning must return in) come from the catalog (models.json), not from here. 'catalog' is the models.dev provider id to look models up in.

_sources.app_headers: OpenRouter app attribution docs: HTTP-Referer is the app's URL, X-Title its name; both optional
_sources.cache_control: OpenRouter prompt-caching docs: Anthropic and Qwen cache only at cache_control breakpoints; OpenAI, DeepSeek, Grok, Moonshot, Groq, Z.AI cache automatically. Measured 2026-09-30 (10k-token prompt, tool loop): claude-haiku-4.5 step $0.0012 vs ~$0.0105, qwen3-coder-flash $0.00022 vs $0.00044. Gemini left out: explicit breakpoints write a new cache every request (gemini-3.1-flash-lite $0.0038 vs $0.0027 without); its implicit caching is automatic
_sources.reasoning_style: OpenRouter docs: reasoning {effort | enabled}; pi-ai thinkingFormat 'openrouter'
_sources.reasoning_details: handled by the openai-chat translator for every provider (OpenRouter, Bifrost)

_sources.max_tokens_field: OpenAI: max_tokens is deprecated and rejected by reasoning models
_sources.reasoning_style: OpenAI reasoning_effort; 'off' is 'none' where models.dev lists it

_sources.thinking: effort vs budget per model from models.dev reasoning_options

_sources.reasoning_field: models.dev interleaved.field = reasoning_content (its own reasoning must come back in a tool loop)

_sources.about: vLLM, llama.cpp server, LM Studio, Ollama's OpenAI endpoint, or any gateway (Bifrost, LiteLLM proxy)
